format: shadowveil idle clips v1 (no native clip format in rig/index.html / runtime-contract v1.6.1)
spec: value(t) = linear interpolation of keys[param] (viewKeys[view][param] overrides for that view); t wraps at duration; params not listed stay at their default; eyes and hair: rig auto
units: rig param units (-1..1; body deg = value x 25, BodyLean x 8, Wrist x 25; finger curl 0..1, f1 = 0.5)

idle_arm_sway.notes: limit test: shoulders reach exactly +1.0 (out/forward, R at 2.03 s, L at 2.63 s) and -1.0 (in/back, R at 6.03 s, L at 6.63 s) once per loop; elbows (flex only) peak 0.6 at 2.37 s (R) / 2.97 s (L), min 0.12; left lags right 0.6 s, elbows lag shoulders 0.35 s; BodyLean +-0.04 trailing 0.3 s; legs 0 (feet planted, no lift or slide). Front/back: + = out from the body (tpose: up); profiles: + = forward.

idle_weight_shift.notes: front/back: hips +-6 deg held on each side, -12 deg peak at 6.0 s (knee ~0.9 of limit); knee/ankle solved per view so the ankle keeps its x and the foot stays level. The pelvis is the rig root and cannot translate, so the feet rise by L1(1-cos th)+L2(1-cos psi) (~3 px at 6 deg, ~14 px at 12 deg). Profiles: the unloaded knee softens.

idle_arm_settle.notes: shoulders drift +-0.25 with peaks ShoulderL ~0.92 @2.2 s, ShoulderR ~-0.9 @5.6 s; elbows lag 0.35 s, peaks ~0.9
